facts.text: Under the Whitman 10% Promise, an admitted family's financial contribution toward tuition will never exceed 10% of their income.

sources.title: The Whitman 10% Promise | Whitman College
sources.quote: That's the promise in the name. Your family's contribution toward Whitman tuition will never exceed 10% of your income. Full financial need met. Whitman College
